sections.title: charaNam
lyrics: nee idhu samayam nEril varuvAi nimala vinAyaka shEzhum pAdhA
1 nee thA pAmAlai shoodum nAthA hErambhA
2 nee varam aruLi nee sakala uyir nee yena maraigaL neethiyai mOzhiyum
3 nirutharkAla gajamukhAsura samara nipuNa vijaya shubhakara guNa ramaNa nilavum aval pori kadalaiyum niraiya mOdhakamum uNavarikoLum niradhishaya viraivil
4 neeL bhuvimEl unadhu mahimaiyai pugalubhayavaridam sadhA vaLarvAi nidhamunadhadimElariNai thozhudhananE yEnadhu thuyaram agala ini yELiyEn munam
